`handoff` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Creates and consumes durable handoff/context records so another agent or later session can continue with the decisions, constraints, evidence, and next actions that matter.

## When to use it

Use this skill when the user asks to create, read, update, search, summarize, or continue from handoff/context records so another agent or future session can pick up the work safely.

Typical requests include:

- “Create a handoff for the next coding agent.”
- “Continue from the latest handoff for this task.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill handoff
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill handoff
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/handoff/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

A handoff is executable context, not a transcript dump. Keep it compact, factual, and scoped to what the next actor needs.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/handoff/SKILL.md` exists and that `handoff` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `handoff` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
